label: Sum aggregation
subgoals: List the neighbors of the target node
Add their features to get the aggregate
Apply the weights and the activation to self and aggregate

label: Mean and max aggregation
subgoals: Divide the neighbor sum by the degree for the mean
Take the largest neighbor feature for the max
Clip a negative pre-activation to zero under ReLU

label: Degree-normalized GCN layers
subgoals: Add one to every degree for the self-loops
Divide each feature by the square root of the two degrees
Sum the normalized terms including the node itself
